text_lines: For the wisdom of the Scriptures and the light of the Gospel, we pray: Lord, hear us.
For teachers, catechists, and all who proclaim your word, we pray: Lord, hear us.
For those who seek understanding and renewal, we pray: Lord, hear us.
For the faithful departed and all in need of comfort, we pray: Lord, hear us.
For the growth of the Church in holiness and charity, we pray: Lord, hear us.
